messages:
sasha_release: deploybot flagged a hotfix candidate r12.3.1-hotfix -> canary. Root cause: auth-cache TTL regression causing intermittent 503s on embedding paths. Requesting expedited prod cut in +10m if no objections. @liz_oncall @nate_ops please ack. :exclamation:

deploybot: [automated] canary rollout started: 10% traffic -> 174 canaries. health checks passing so far. logs: https://deploy.internal/redwood/r12.3.1-hotfix event=fb1234

nate_ops: seen pager spike at ~03:10 UTC, looks like same 503 signature on /v1/embeds. Are we certain it's TTL config and not downstream cache?

liz_oncall: confirmed 503s in embedding stack, hits at 03:08-03:12. Rolling back staging didn't change error pattern, adding traces to the ticket.

zhou_eng: quick mitigation = pin TTL back to 3600s. Patch ready in PR `#7894`, branch `fix/auth-cache-ttl`. Plan: push to canary, validate, then promote to prod as r12.3.1-hotfix.

cara_pm: what's the customer impact window if we cut now vs waiting for full investigation? need a short release note for support.

sasha_release: low risk — purely config value, no model or schema changes. We still require two approvals: ops + oncall. @nate_ops can you +1? @liz_oncall please confirm.

nate_ops: +1. Verified canary smoke: no latency regression, 5xx trending down in canary.

liz_oncall: +1 from oncall. I'll watch dashboards for 15m after prod. :thumbsup:

deploybot: deploy triggered by sasha_release at 7965432120. Rollout plan: canary -> 50% -> 100% if health checks remain green.

zhou_eng: rollback plan ready: `deploybot rollback r12.3.1-hotfix` (expected revert ~90s). Rollback playbook excerpt: ```1) check error spikes 2) run rollback 3) scale replicas back 4) notify channels``` Link: https://runbooks/internal/auth-cache-rollback.md

cara_pm: draft release note: "Fixed auth-cache TTL regression causing transient 503s on embedding endpoints. No user data changes." Will publish once cut confirmed.

sasha_release: tagging security for audit trail: @security-team FYI (no action unless requested).

nate_ops: monitoring update: canary error rate down to 0.8% 2m after patch. Healthy.

liz_oncall: prod cut completed at 7965432155. Initial telemetry stable, rolling window shows errors back to baseline. Will update incident ticket with timings.

deploybot: [automated] rollout complete: 100% prod at 7965432155. changelog: r12.3.1-hotfix -> pinned config TTL=3600.

sasha_release: thanks all — closing expedited approval loop. Will attach runbook snippet and release note to the ticket.
